title: Headless TTW Thought Control (DLC04MQ04): from Desmond's Cogwave Jammer through the Ferris wheel to Calvert Mansion blown apart (stage 200, quest completed; the jammer installed, Desmond's side)

actions.text: Given: the player out of Vault 101 (MQ01 10), The Local Flavor, Walking With Spirits and Hearing Voices done (DLC04MQ01, MQ02, MQ03 200: their chains). DLC04MQ03's last stage starts DLC04MQ04 and sets 10 [observed]; done here directly so this chain runs alone. The player stands on Point Lookout's landing (where the voyage puts the player [observed]).

Path (Desmond's side: the jammer installed): Desmond's talk about Professor Calvert to the Cogwave Jammer (DLC04MQ01DesmondST10Greeting3, 3b, 3a1, 3a1a, 3a1a1: stage 20, the jammer, the Ferris wheel made usable), the Brain's offer heard near the wheel (DLC04MQ04BrainContactTriggerSCRIPT: 25), the Ferris wheel's bottom car (DLC04FerrisWheelWheelSCRIPT, its message's first button: 99, the jammer fitted, the wheel turns: 100), and the walk back to Calvert Mansion, which blows apart (DLC04MQ04ExplosionControlSCRIPT: 200, A Meeting of the Minds by DLC04MQ05a 10). The other ending (the jammer destroyed in the trash compactor for the Brain: 101, DLC04MQ05b) is left out.
Travel stand-in: up the road to Calvert Mansion and Desmond.

milestone: DLC04MQ04 20, to the Ferris wheel

actions.text: Travel stand-in: to the boardwalk. Near the Ferris wheel the Brain speaks in the player's head (DLC04MQ04BrainContactTriggerSCRIPT starts DLC04TheBrainNPCSCRIPT's offer, DLC04BrainTalkPlayer lines 0 to 4; the last one's end sets 25) [observed]; the wheel takes the jammer only past 20 [observed: DLC04FerrisWheelWheelSCRIPT].

The wheel's bottom car (DLC04FerrisWheelWheelSCRIPT [observed]): its message, the first button fits the jammer (99), and 1.5 s later the wheel turns the jammer up (100, the tribals of the boardwalk turn hostile).

actions.text: Travel stand-in: back to Calvert Mansion; at its grounds (DLC04MQ04ExplosionControlSCRIPT [observed]) the mansion blows apart, explosion by explosion, and the script's last step sets 200.
